description: Remove some qualities and/or the original file (backup) of ONE CONVERTED video to free storage, keeping the video. The removed items disappear right away and are deleted for good after retention_days (30); until then panda_cancel_partial_deletion restores them. Videos from an external source are refused. Refused when it would leave the video with no quality: the API would send the whole video to the trash instead — use panda_delete_videos to delete a video. Returns {retention_days, action, remaining_qualities, ignored, partial_deletion}.

backup.description: true = remove the original uploaded file (backup)

qualities.description: Qualities to remove, as in the video's available_resolutions (e.g. ['1080p', '720p'])

name: panda_request_partial_deletion
title: Request Partial Deletion
